  ClippingShape at [66]

=== OFFICIAL EMISSION PATTERN SUMMARY ===

The official encoder does NOT enforce a fixed Style/Run ordering.
Runs can precede, follow, or interleave with Styles.
The styleId field is a pure artboard-relative index — forward references work.

=== OUR BUILDER EMISSION PATTERN ===

Our builder uses: Styles first (all styles), then Runs (all runs).
  Text → Style1(+Fill1) → Style2(+Fill2) → Run1 → Run2 → Run3

This is structurally correct and different from the official ordering,
but functionally identical since styleId resolution is index-based.
